ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 1258 de 2008 (SAS regime); Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT prevention framework); Código Penal, Art. 323 et seq.; Decreto 410 de 1971 (Código de Comercio, Art. 260 control test); Decreto 830 de 2021 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB, adding Title 1.5.12 to Decreto 1625 de 2016); Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica, Capítulo X (SAGRILAFT); Law 2195 de 2022 (corporate transparency and anti-corruption amendments).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized General Power of Attorney appointing the Colombian legal representative and incorporating attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of origin of each foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the origin state is a contracting party; otherwise consular legalization at the Colombian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry or corporate registrar of the foreign jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Authenticated Memorandum and Articles of Association / constitutional documents of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry, notary, or competent corporate authority of the foreign jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized and certified copy of the passport of each individual shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of nationality/residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization, or notarized certification accepted under the origin state's authentication rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of criminal record / police clearance of each foreign individual shareholder, director, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, judicial record authority, or competent public authority of the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-registration and ongoing screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against the Colombian UIAF and Superintendencia de Sociedades PEP databases, the OFAC SDN List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the FATF/GAFILAT public statements, and Colombian domestic lists of persons linked to terrorism and organized crime. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, unusual sourcing of funds, and cross-border used-machinery transactions; source-of-wealth documentation, beneficial-ownership cascade evidence, and transaction records must be retained for a minimum of 10 years in accordance with Colombian commercial and supervisory requirements.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES - Registro Único Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co) operated by Confecámaras; initial name search and reservation are executed through the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be written in the Latin alphabet. A name expressed in a foreign language must be transliterated accurately into Latin characters, and a Spanish translation should be registered where required. The legal name must be capable of being pronounced and recorded in the Spanish-language registry and must not mislead as to the type or business of the company. Under Law 1258 of 2008, the corporate name of a SAS must be followed by the expression 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or the abbreviation 'S.A.S.'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the applicant may immediately submit a distinct alternative name or request reconsideration (recurso de reposición) before the same Cámara de Comercio within the statutory business days set by the CPACA. If the rejection is confirmed, the applicant may file an appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; the appeal must be lodged within 10 business days of notice of the adverse decision. Exhaustion of the administrative remedy allows a subsequent challenge before the competent Administrative Tribunal. The name reservation may be renewed for an additional period where the local chamber rules permit, provided the underlying document remains valid.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is acceptable at the initial registration stage only if it corresponds to a real, physical, and identifiable Colombian address at which legal notices can be served and where the statutory files are available. For a used-heavy-machinery trading company conducting cross-border transactions, bills of lading, customs entry, storage, and inspection activity require actual commercial presence or a contracted local operational facility; a nominal virtual mailbox alone will not satisfy the commercial substance and tax-domicile requirements of DIAN and the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high; the probability of an unannounced on-site inspection in the first 24 months is approximately 40-55% for a cross-border used construction machinery dealer engaged in import/export and high-value wire transfers, with increased likelihood where SAGRILAFT obligations apply and where the registry reflects a virtual-only address.

Preparation, signature, and notarization of the SAS constitution document and bylaws (including certified Spanish-language drafting)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff schedule plus prevailing market legal fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff based on declared capital and document volume

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Issuance of the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (certificado de existencia y representación legal)
Apostille or consular legalization of all foreign incorporation, identity, and good standing documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign competent authority and/or Colombian consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fee schedule of the authorizing state

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per page or per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market flat fee for a medium-risk trading company

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and submission support for the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance officer engaged through external counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Appointment of local legal representative and registered agent services for the first corporate year

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008 (Articles 1-5, 17 and 45), as complemented by the Código de Comercio (Articles 98-110, 372-376) and Decree 1074 of 2015 (Registro Único Empresarial y Social); private-incorporation regime under Article 5 of Law 1258/2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) of the company's registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating through the RUES; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) for tax registration; Superintendencia de Sociedades for corporate oversight.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) registered in the Registro Mercantil / RUES; where real property is contributed, the instrument must be elevated to a public deed (Escritura Pública) before a Notary and subsequently registered with the Chamber of Commerce.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; capital is freely fixed in the bylaws under Law 1258/2008 art. 17 and payment terms are agreed by the shareholders. Shares must be fully subscribed and paid within the term stated in the bylaws. No escrow account is required; however, foreign-investment contributions must be paid into a Colombian bank account in the company's name and registered with the Banco de la República within five (5) business days of receipt.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD OF SHAREHOLDERS' RESOLUTION No. 1 — [COMPANY] S.A.S. WHEREAS the bylaws have been subscribed by the sole shareholder and the requirements of Law 1258 of 2008 have been met; RESOLVED: 1. The incorporation of [Company] S.A.S. is ratified, and the subscribed shares and capital contributions set forth in the bylaws are accepted. 2. The registered office is adopted at [Address], Bogotá D.C., Colombia. 3. [Full Name] is appointed Legal Representative (Representante Legal Principal) and [Full Name] as Alternate, with the powers contained in Article [_] of the bylaws. 4. The appointed officers are authorized to execute the Chamber of Commerce registration, obtain the NIT/RUT before DIAN, open bank accounts, and complete all ancillary filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Availability Search (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the intended registered domicile via the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the RUES portal or the Chamber of Commerce's virtual counterpart, file the name-search application, and request the 'Certificado de Homonimia'. The certificate confirms that the proposed corporate name (e.g., '[COMPANY] EQUIPOS S.A.S.') does not conflict with names already reserved or registered by other entities. Secure the reservation for a 30-day term to permit formal execution of the bylaws.
required_dossiers: Name-search application form
Identification document of the founder or appointed representative (passport or national ID)
Proposed corporate name, with up to three alternatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber returns a positive homonymy result (identical or confusingly similar name), re-file the name search with up to three alternative names chosen by the founders; the new search is processed on the same service channel and no substantive fee is lost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Private Constitution Instrument (Bylaws) and Capital Subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders; Notaría Pública when real property is contributed (public deed execution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the 'Documento Privado de Constitución' governed by Law 1258 of 2008, setting out the bylaws: company name with the 'S.A.S.' tag, registered-office address (domicilio social), specific corporate purpose of wholesale remarketing of used construction excavators and related machinery (ISIC 4659), subscribed and paid capital with payment deadlines, classes and series of shares, shareholder-meeting rules, legal-representation clauses, and officer appointments. Each founder signs the instrument; signatures must be authenticated before a notary where the law, a bank, or the Chamber requires certified execution. If real property is contributed, the instrument must be executed as a public deed before a Notary and then registered with the Oficina de Registro de Instrumentos Públicos.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws / private constitution document
Valid national ID or passport for each founder and legal representative
Certificado de Homonimia (name-reservation certificate)
Power of attorney (poder) if a founder is represented
Evidence of initial capital deposit in a Colombian bank account if the payment terms so require
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the submission is queried for inconsistency (e.g., missing page numbers, mismatched share subscription, or incomplete authentication), prepare and sign an 'adenda' (amending annex) correcting the defect, re-paginate the instrument, and re-notarize if the original was executed as a public deed; the corrected instrument is then re-filed at the same Chamber or notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Mercantile Registry and Chamber of Commerce Registration (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) – Registro Mercantil / RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed constitution instrument, the homonymy certificate, the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) entrepreneur form, and proof of payment of the Chamber registration tariff (for 2025, the base registration right is approximately COP 46,000, equivalent to about US$ 11, plus a proportional tariff on subscribed capital exceeding the applicable UVT threshold). The Chamber verifies the instrument, issues the 'matrícula mercantil', produces the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal', generates the company's 'pre-RUT' for DIAN purposes, records the appointment of officers, publishes the incorporation in the Boletín Mercantil, and registers the company's statutory books (libro de actas and libro de registro de accionistas).
required_dossiers: Original signed private constitution instrument (two copies)
Certificado de Homonimia
RUE registration form signed by the legal representative
Copy of the legal representative's ID
Proof of payment of Chamber tariffs (PSE or bank receipt)
Acceptance letters of the legal representative and alternate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber files an objection, the founders must cure within the statutory term by submitting a corrective declaration ('aclaración') signed by the legal representative; if the correction is substantive (e.g., name or capital), execute an amending document, refile it with the Chamber, and update the same RUES record.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Taxpayer Registration with DIAN: NIT, RUT, Electronic Invoicing and Foreign-Investment Exchange Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales); Banco de la República (exchange registration of foreign direct investment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Chamber issues the pre-RUT, finalize the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) at the DIAN portal or service office, confirming the NIT, corporate tax regime, and tax responsibilities (income tax, VAT if deemed applicable, industry and commerce tax is municipal). Activate the electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) system in the DIAN portal, either by accrediting a software provider or enabling the free DIAN invoicing solution. If foreign shareholders contribute capital, instruct the receiving Colombian bank to file the 'Declaración de Cambio por Inversión Directa' (Form No. 6) with Banco de la República within five (5) business days of the remittance, under the foreign-exchange regime (Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83).
required_dossiers: Chamber-issued pre-RUT or Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Company NIT assigned by DIAN
Identity documents and individual RUT of the legal representative
Bank certification of paid-in capital
If FDI: foreign-remittance proof (SWIFT advice) and Form No. 6 for the foreign-exchange declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT due to a data mismatch with the Chamber record, request the Chamber to rectify the mercantile registration and then re-present the RUT application with the corrected certificate. Late registration of the foreign-exchange declaration is cured by filing a late declaration with the Banco de la República and paying the per-day late-filing surcharge; electronic-invoicing objections are remedied by re-sending the platform registration and supporting documentation to the DIAN service desk within the indicated term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial Registry, Land-Use Certificate and Civil Defense / Fire Safety Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría de Hacienda (ICA registration); Secretaría de Planeación (uso de suelo); Cuerpo de Bomberos Oficial (fire safety)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing operations at the registered office or warehouse, register the company in the municipal Registro de Industria y Comercio (ICA) and obtain the Certificado de Uso de Suelo from the municipal planning office confirming that wholesale machinery trading and related storage is an authorized use at the address. Obtain the Concepto Técnico de Bomberos (fire-safety inspection) for the premises; if premises exceed 100 square meters or include hydraulic/mechanical workshop areas, install extinguishers, emergency lighting, and signage per the Colombian NFPA-based regulation and secure the annual fire-safety certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Chamber certificate)
RUT / NIT
Lease agreement or certificate of ownership of premises
Land-use query form and property certificate (certificado catastral)
Fire-safety inspection checklist and electrical/facility documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality denies the land-use certificate because the activity is not expressly listed, request a written use variance (consulta de uso de suelo) or select an alternative compliant location within the same municipality; if the fire brigade issues an unfavorable concept, execute the required corrective works, schedule a re-inspection, and present the corrected certificate to the ICA registry to complete the municipal activation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation Registrations: Employer Social-Security Enrollment, Occupational Health (SGSST) and Foreign-Trade Permissions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: UGPP / SISPRO social-security systems; ARL insurer (administradora de riesgos laborales); Caja de Compensación; Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (VUPE) for imports
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the S.A.S. as an employer with the social-security operator (SISPRO) and register personnel with an EPS (health), a pension fund (AFP), an ARL, and a Caja de Compensación; implement the mandatory SGSST program under Resolution 0312 of 2019, appoint a risk officer, and maintain the occupational-risk classification with the ARL. If the company will import used excavators, apply through the VUPE single window to MINCIT for the prior registration of used capital goods (model year, serial numbers, certificate of origin) and, where applicable, obtain the environmental import authorization from MinAmbiente for used machinery containing refrigerants or hazardous residues; file the import customs declaration with DIAN and engage an authorized customs broker.
required_dossiers: RUT and Chamber certificate
Employer enrollment form (planilla) for the General Social Security System and caja de compensación
ARL contract and employee payroll roster
Initial SGSST self-assessment under Resolution 0312 of 2019
If importing: pro-forma invoice, VUPE registration form, technical data sheet of each excavator (model, year, VIN), and environmental declaration confirming absence of hazardous residues
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A rejection of the VUPE import registration due to missing technical or environmental documents is cured by re-filing with a supplementary technical dossier and an environmental assessment of the equipment (draining of hydraulic fluids, removal of batteries, and cleanliness certificate). Employer social-security objections are corrected by rectifying the 'planilla' in the SISPRO-PILA system and paying any recalculated contributions; if a labor inspector queries the SGSST program, complete it through a certified occupational-health consultant and resubmit within the remedial period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial operating license applies to the pure wholesale trade of used construction machinery (ISIC 4659); the authorities that may intervene are the Cámara de Comercio (mercantile registration), the municipal Alcaldía (ICA and land-use certificates), the Cuerpo de Bomberos (fire safety), and, only for importation of used heavy equipment, the Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo (MINCIT) through VUPE and the Ministerio de Ambiente for environmental import clearance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no manufacturing or industrial operating license is required for wholesale remarketing of secondhand hydraulic earthmovers and rollers; the activity is governed by the mercantile registration and municipal operating permits.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible (MinAmbiente) and the Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for projects requiring a license; regional Corporaciones Autónomas Regionales (CAR) for local environmental oversight.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no full EIA is required because the activity is a commercial trading operation not listed in the mandatory-licensing annexes of Decree 1076 of 2015; importation of secondhand excavators triggers only a prior environmental review and customs clearance for used capital goods (verification that the equipment contains no ozone-depleting substances or hazardous residues), and an environmental registration could apply if a physical depot or washing/repair facility is later established.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Where a warehouse, depot, or any wastewater-generating facility is operated, discharges must comply with the national wastewater discharge parameters of Resolution 631 of 2015 (pH, COD, BOD5, TSS, and oil-grease concentration); storage and handling of used machinery must prevent soil contamination, with drainage and spill-containment provisions per Resolution 4741 of 2011 on hazardous waste; atmospheric emissions from any stationary generator or thermal equipment must meet the point-source limits of Resolution 909 of 2008. As a pure trading operation, the company is not subject to production-line emissions thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification (Concepto Técnico / Certificado de Bomberos) from the Cuerpo de Bomberos of the municipality, including extinguishers, emergency exits, and signage; structural-load and racking inspections if heavy-machinery parts storage is conducted on site; occupational health and safety clearance through the mandatory SGSST program under Resolution 0312 of 2019, employee medical assessments, emergency-response planning, and ARL (occupational-risk) coverage before employees engage in administrative or warehouse duties.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – national tax and customs authority; electronic portal: https://www.dian.gov.co and transactional platform: https://muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) File the S.A.S. deed with the Chamber of Commerce to obtain the business certificate; 2) Register the company with DIAN in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) electronically or in person, selecting the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and requesting VAT responsibility code 'R' and 'Exportador' status; 3) Wait for the NIT to be assigned; 4) Obtain digital certificate (certificado digital) from a certified CA to enable e-invoicing and customs operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (resident S.A.S. taxed on worldwide taxable income; no pass-through or check-the-box classification)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections exist. Available elections include: (i) Colombian Holding Company (CHC) regime for qualified holding companies; (ii) Free Trade Zone (Zona Franca) user election giving a 20% income tax rate subject to requirements; (iii) Simplificado annual regime (SIMPLE) for small entities with annual income below 100,000 UVT and under 100 employees; (iv) tax consolidation election for groups satisfying control and economic interest tests under Law 2010 of 2019.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto al Valor Agregado (Value Added Tax) administered by DIAN
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For a Colombian legal entity, no economic threshold applies: registration as a VAT-responsible taxpayer is mandatory upon undertaking any taxable sale or service. For non-resident digital service providers, a 30,000 UVT threshold applies (approx. COP 1,260,000,000 in 2024), but this is not relevant to a domestic S.A.S. exporter.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturación Electrónica de Venta (electronic invoicing) with near-real-time transmission to DIAN. Taxpayers in the e-invoicing system must issue XML invoices signed with a certified digital certificate, compensate the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica), and obtain DIAN's validation prior to delivering the invoice. For exports, the same electronic invoice description is used with additional 'Exportación' identifiers, and the invoice must reference the accepted export declaration. Reverse-charge or e-invoice equivalence rules apply to foreign-to-local services but not to the underlying export sale.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sales of tangible goods (including used construction machinery) are zero-rated for VAT provided the seller is a VAT-registered exporter, the goods are physically shipped from Colombian customs territory to a foreign destination, the transaction is evidenced by a final export declaration, and the export proceeds are repatriated within the legal term. Used equipment qualifies only if the seller holds and can transfer title free of liens and the equipment is not otherwise excluded by special environmental or antique trade legislation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) transmitted electronically through DIAN/VUCE
Bill of Lading (signed ocean bill of lading or air waybill evidencing physical shipment)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificate of foreign currency compensation issued by the Colombian intermediary bank)
Commercial invoice identified as export sale and marked 0% IVA with CUFE
Pre-shipment inspection certificate for used machinery (if required by destination country or DIAN)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may reopen VAT returns for up to five years and recharacterise any export as a local taxable sale if the mandatory export formalities are missing or inaccurate. Consequences include payment of the 19% IVA on the taxable base, default interest, a penalty for tax inaccuracy of up to 100% of the omitted tax, and in fraud cases penalties under Article 308 of the Criminal Code together with imprisonment for tax evasion. DIAN cross-verifies export declarations, e-invoices, customs shipping records and FX remittance certificates.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), acting through the Junta Directiva and jointly with the Ministerio de Hacienda y Crédito Público; the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia supervises the authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (IMCs), while DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) governs the underlying customs and foreign-trade declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso operates under a managed float and is de jure convertible for current-account transactions (goods trade, freight, insurance, technical services, and profit-related remittances) when settled through the official exchange market (mercado cambiario) involving an IMC. Capital-account operations, including equity contributions to the S.A.S., are liberalized but must be registered with the Banco de la República foreign-investment registry (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) so that subsequent dividend and capital repatriation flows can be legally processed; in practical terms, profit remittance is conditional on (i) prior registration of the direct investment, (ii) processing through an IMC with the applicable Declaración de Cambio, (iii) available audited retained earnings, and (iv) satisfaction of the domestic dividend withholding rules. Unregistered capital contributions or remittances of proceeds deriving from non-registered equity will be blocked by the IMC and recharacterized for exchange-control and tax purposes, generating administrative rather than monetary convertibility hurdles.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory framework: Law 9 of 1991, implemented by Resolution No. 48/2000 of the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 of 2007. Export proceeds from goods, including secondhand hydraulic excavators, rollers, and spare parts, must be canalized into Colombia by sale to or deposit with an IMC, or by crediting an authorized foreign-currency account in Colombia or a Banco de la República-approved compensation account abroad, within six (6) months following the date of receipt of the foreign-currency payment. There is no mandatory percentage surrender or forced conversion into COP; exporters may retain USD balances in permissible accounts, but the IMC filing (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones, supported by the DIAN export declaration and the commercial invoice) must evidence channeling within the statutory window. Failure to channel within the six-month term constitutes an exchange-control infraction attracting fines and monetary sanctions, in practice up to 200% of the uncanalized amount, imposed by Banco de la República, with additional DIAN penalties in cases of misdeclaration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (annual commercial registration renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del Domicilio Social – Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 31 March; no grace period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal incurs a chamber-of-commerce penalty equal to 10% of the annual renewal tariff per year of delay, plus monthly interest; failure to renew for five consecutive years triggers cancellation of mercantile registration and administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual approved financial statements and minutes of the shareholders' meeting (filing copies for commercial registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (via RUES) and, if supervised, Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting must approve annual accounts by 31 March; registration of financial statements must occur within 15 business days after approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may trigger fines up to 200 SMMLV, restriction on dividend payments and legal standing; continued default can lead to cancellation of commercial registration and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) confirmation and declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually according to DIAN's exógena information-return calendar for the prior tax year; within 60 days after any shareholding transfer affecting direct or indirect ownership by more than 10%.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties for omission or inaccuracy up to 1,350 UVT (approx. USD 10,000), possible tax assessment adjustments, and anti-money-laundering enforcement; continued non-compliance can result in registry suspension.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (annual corporate income tax and complementary declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year fiscal periods, the return is due between the last business day of August and the first business day of September of the following year, depending on the taxpayer's NIT last digit under the annual DIAN resolution.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extemporaneous filing penalty of 5% of tax payable per month, capped at 100%; unpaid tax accrues official daily interest; repeated non-filing may prompt forced official assessment and criminal fiscal enforcement.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) if, in the most recent fiscal year, any of the following thresholds is met: gross assets exceeding 5,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 1.6 million); gross revenues exceeding 3,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 0.97 million); or more than 200 employees. Mandatory independent audit also applies when required by the bylaws or by order of the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian GAAP: full IFRS (NIIF Plenas) for Group 1 companies; IFRS for SMEs (NIF PYMES) for Group 2 companies, being the applicable framework for a used heavy-machinery trading S.A.S. unless it qualifies as Group 1.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must maintain a 'Libro de Registro de Accionistas' and 'Libro de Actas' at the registered office. Any shareholding transfer exceeding a direct or indirect 10% participation must be recorded and reported to DIAN within 60 calendar days. The annual UBO confirmation is filed with DIAN through the exógena return, including the ultimate beneficiary's full name, tax identification, country of residence, and control chain.
